messages:
Nia: Heads-up: CEO Alex will post an exec update + benchmark callout Thu 13:00 UTC. We need embargo coordination and a short Q&A for reporters. Draft blog and tweet deck in the doc: https://go.redwood/ceo-update-draft
Marco: Copy. I'll prepare embargo list and notify top-tier press at 12:20 UTC. Who's owning live Q&A? @Tess?
Tess: I can handle Q&A. Will prepare two on-the-record engineers and one backup from Product. Also drafting three boiled-down answers for likely latency/cost questions.
press-bot: Reminder scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 12:20 UTC (in 40m)
Legal: Quick flag: CEO quote mentions "industry-leading latency". We should soften to "industry-competitive median latency" to avoid absolutes. Also remove any comparative logos from the deck.
CEO-Alex: Thanks Legal. I'm fine with the wording change. Keep the quote emotional but precise. Final quote in doc updated.
Nia: Action items:
- Marco: embargo emails + press list
- Tess: Q&A + engineer contacts
- Legal: final sign-off on wording (please respond by 12:00 UTC)
- Comms: social schedule + exec thread draft
Please react when you've completed your item.
Marco: Press list ready: FT, Bloomberg, Axios, TechCrunch EU, The Information. Embargo emails queued for 12:20 and follow-up at 12:45 for APAC contacts.
Tess: Q&A draft: 1) measurement methodology 2) guidance on when to use Dedicated vs Hosted 3) how we handle fallbacks. Adding engineer blurbs.
Legal: Wording approved at 11:52 UTC. Replace "industry-leading" with "industry-competitive" in the quote.
Comms: Social copy drafted. Need final hero image (Alex headshot + benchmark chart). Design says image ready at 12:05 UTC.
Nia: Publish flow note: we'll lift embargo at 13:00 UTC. Manual publish command if needed:
```
# manual publish
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" -d '{"slug":"ceo-update-benchmarks"}'
```
Marco: Embargo email includes: TL;DR, embargo time, CEO quote, link to embargoed post, and who to contact for on-the-record comments (Tess). Sending at 12:20.
press-bot: Sent: embargo_email_sender fired at 12:20 UTC.
Tess: Engineers confirmed: Lina (infra) and Omar (runtime) will be available 12:45-14:00 UTC for reporter calls. Backup: Priya. Q&A doc linked in the embargo email.
Comms: Social scheduled to post at 13:05 UTC (T+5) to give press a head-start. Also scheduling a pinned update thread for live replies.
Nia: One more: Ops, can you increase log retention to 4h for the window and open a surge-control thread in #eng-oncall?
Marco: Ops escalation pinged. They'll bump retention and open #surge-watch.
press-bot: Note: embargo_email_sender follow-up scheduled at 12:45 UTC for APAC list.
Tess: Final checklist: embargo emails sent :white_check_mark:, Q&A ready :white_check_mark:, hero image ready :white_check_mark:, legal approved :white_check_mark:, ops on surge-watch :white_check_mark:. Good to go.
Nia: Great. I'll be on publish at 12:58 UTC for a dry run and lift embargo at 13:00. If anything blocks, post in #release-control and ping me directly.
